title: Swim.com Workout Distance Leaderboard
dataSources: Swim.com workouts (`swimcom:workout`), MySwimPro sessions (`myswimpro:session`), pool lap logs (`pool:lap`), and swim meet results (`swim:meet`).
app: Swim.com workout exports, MySwimPro session logs, pool lap counters, swim meet results, and interval pace trackers forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=swimcom:workout distance_m=*
| stats sum(distance_m) as total_value, avg(distance_m) as avg_value by stroke_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks stroke values by total and average distance across Swim.com workout events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `distance_m` values for each Swim.com workout event and review total and average distance by stroke.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total distance.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which stroke shows the biggest distance numbers in your Swim.com workout data.
